key_findings: Dry-run counted as real is blocked.
Reasons existed; impacts were absent before L10.
Full commit SHA was not visible before L10.

findings.description: Final audit gate was absent at design time.
Missing/skipped metrics had no explicit impact.
Final report views did not clearly expose a full commit SHA.

proposed_harness.name: final_audit_gate
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validates P14, coverage, missing impacts, provenance, reports, and source hashes.

proposed_harness.name: final_audit_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Covers dry-run real regression, missing impact, and report source-truth failure.

implementation_plan.rationale: Avoid report backflow and P14 execution.

acceptance_criteria: No dry-run or fake entry is real coverage.
Every missing-like metric has reason and impact.
Final HTML/report exposes commit SHA and source artifacts.
risks: Report HTML could be validated instead of JSON sources.
P02 1000-node planner could be counted as real coverage.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not infer metrics from HTML/CSV/SVG.
notes: Risk review approved the design direction; L10 must close impact and commit visibility gaps before PASS.
